name: Distributed execution, artifact upload, and node affinity

scenarios.name: Run scraping job across multiple workers

steps.text: I have a ScraperType configuration with "scraper_engine" set to "requests"
the job is configured to run with 3 parallel shards
the Swarm Forge orchestrator schedules the job
the job should run on 3 distinct worker nodes
each worker should produce a parsed artifact
the artifact "parsed_result.json" should be uploaded to the job artifact store

scenarios.name: Respect node affinity and resource limits

steps.text: a ScraperType configuration with "browser_type" set to "chrome"
the job requests GPU false and memory 2GB
the job should be placed on a node that satisfies the resource constraints
